<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("=== Current right panel buttons ===")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    if boundary:
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        if n['pixels'] == 3 and 30 <= min_row <= 50 and 35 <= min_col <= 60:
            pressed = "PRESSED" if n['color'] == 'B' else "unpressed"
            if n['color'] == 'B':
                print(f"  pos=({min_row},{min_col}), color={n['color']} ({pressed})")

print("\n=== Current left panel buttons ===")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    if boundary:
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        if n['pixels'] == 3 and 30 <= min_row <= 50 and 5 <= min_col <= 25:
            pressed = "PRESSED" if n['color'] == 'B' else "unpressed"
            if n['color'] == 'B':
                print(f"  pos=({min_row},{min_col}), color={n['color']} ({pressed})")

# Check target shape on left panel
print("\n=== Target shape on left panel ===")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    if boundary:
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        max_row = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
        max_col = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
        # Left panel area, not buttons, not background
        if 5 <= min_row <= 30 and 5 <= min_col <= 25 and n['color'] in ('c', 'G', 'B'):
            if n['pixels'] < 50:  # Small object
                print(f"  pos=({min_row},{min_col}), size=({max_row-min_row+1}x{max_col-min_col+1}), color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Try clicking the target shape

action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 16, 'col': 22}])
print("\nAfter target shape click:")
print("Level completed:", last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
print("Gameplay changed:", last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
